info.name: API CaseTracker - Hindsight Memory Flows
info.description: Demonstrates customer-isolated memory flows with Hindsight for Hack with Bangalore 4.0: (1) Known issue with prior fix, (2) Customer isolation test with identical visible symptoms, (3) New issue requiring investigation, and (4) Learning loop: Retaining a confirmed resolution and recalling it on subsequent analysis.

request.description: Checks backend status and active memory provider (Hindsight vs Demo Memory Mode).
Lists customer API integration profiles, auth protocols, and isolated memory bank IDs.

item.name: Flow 1A: Known Issue - Apex Retail (401 OAuth Key ID Mismatch)

body.raw:
{
  "customer_id": "cust_apex_retail",
  "api_name": "Orders & Webhooks Sync API",
  "api_version": "v2.4",
  "symptoms": "401 Unauthorized returned during webhook registration endpoint (POST /webhooks/subscribe). Client requests fail handshake despite valid client credentials.",
  "error_message": "invalid_token: Token signature validation failed: kid does not match active JWKS key",
  "steps_tried": "Verified client secret in developer portal, tested token endpoint manually via curl (200 OK), rebooted client app."
}

request.description: Recalls past case CASE-1082 from Apex Retail's memory bank: Redis OAuth token cache flush.

item.name: Flow 3A: Retain Confirmed Resolution into Memory (CASE-1105)

body.raw:

  "customer_id": "cust_catalyst_health",

  "steps_tried": "Checked worker thread count, increased request timeout from 30s to 60s, restarted client batch daemon.",

  "verified_fix": "Added compound B-tree index on (organization_id, export_status, created_at) and set query MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 15000.",
  "verified_by": "Elena Rostova (Senior Integration Specialist)",
  "case_id": "CASE-1105",
  "title": "Batch Export 504: Database Read Replica Lag & Missing Compound Index"
}
